record.question: In a balanced diet, protein contributes to how much percentage of the daily energy requirement?
record.explanation: Answer C: 10-15%. A balanced diet commonly supplies about 10–15% of energy from protein; needs vary with age, pregnancy, and health. Source/context note: Macronutrient ranges vary across national guidance and life stage. Reference: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/healthy-diet. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
